notes.zh: 审阅说明：戴森球每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。dyson_sphere_3、_4 阶段只发出隐藏的提示消息 utopia.4006，没有可读事件。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Dyson Sphere fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order. Stages dyson_sphere_3 and _4 only fire the hidden alert message utopia.4006; there is no readable event for them.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

scope.zh: 戴森球各建造阶段事件、给其他帝国的通知、废墟与修复事件。
scope.en: Dyson Sphere: build-stage events, notices to other empires, the ruin and restoration events.
